verdict.rationale: Marlin's core interaction model is natural-language: users give it a research topic and refine direction through a brief conversational exchange, after which it runs autonomously (docs-9, docs-10, docs-25, docs-27). This matches the AI-native 'operate via natural-language commands' story well, though evidence is entirely first-party marketing copy. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the NL command interface, and detail on the range/flexibility of commands beyond initial topic-setting.
